# CNN

> > CNN is a leading global news organization delivering breaking news, live updates, and in-depth coverage across politics, business, health, science, sports, and lifestyle topics.

CNN provides comprehensive news coverage across multiple verticals including U.S. and international news, politics, business, health, science, climate, weather, sports, travel, and entertainment. The site features breaking news alerts, live updates, video content, podcasts, and analysis from correspondents and expert contributors worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Live Updates
- Video Content
- US News
- World News
- Politics
- Business & Economy
- Israel-Hamas Conflict
- Russia-Ukraine War
- Climate & Weather
- Sports News
- Health & Wellness
- Science & Space
- Current Events
- Geopolitics

## News & Breaking Updates

- [CNN Homepage](https://www.cnn.com): Breaking news, live updates, and trending stories from around the world
- [US News](https://www.cnn.com/us): Latest national stories and breaking updates from across the United States
- [World News](https://www.cnn.com/world): International news covering Europe, Asia, Africa, Middle East, and Americas

## Politics & Government

- [Politics](https://www.cnn.com/politics): Election coverage, fact-checks, and in-depth political analysis
- [Russian Invasion of Ukraine](https://www.cnn.com/world/europe/ukraine): Comprehensive coverage of the Russia-Ukraine war with latest news and analysis
- [Israel-Hamas Conflict](https://www.cnn.com/world/middleeast/israel): Breaking news and political analysis on the Israel-Hamas war

## Business, Markets & Economy

- [Business News](https://www.cnn.com/business): Market coverage, financial news, technology trends, and economic analysis

## Science, Health & Environment

- [Health](https://www.cnn.com/health): Coverage of fitness, nutrition, medicine, wellness, and disease research
- [Science](https://www.cnn.com/science): Science news including NASA missions, space exploration, and scientific research
- [Climate Change](https://www.cnn.com/climate): Global warming coverage and environmental news impacting the planet
- [Weather](https://www.cnn.com/weather): Weather forecasts, severe weather alerts, hurricanes, and storm tracking

## Sports, Travel & Lifestyle

- [Sports](https://www.cnn.com/sports): Sports coverage including football, tennis, motorsport, golf, and international competitions
- [Travel](https://www.cnn.com/travel): Global travel guides, destination tips, and travel stories from around the world
- [Style](https://www.cnn.com/style): Fashion, beauty, design, art, architecture, and luxury lifestyle coverage

## Audio & Multimedia

- [CNN Podcasts](https://www.cnn.com/audio): Podcast directory with news briefings, shows, and audio content from CNN and CNN Español

## Optional

- [CNN Games](https://www.cnn.com/games): Free games, puzzles, crosswords, sudoku, and brain teasers for entertainment
